answer_1.quote: Context-aware neural machine translation (NMT) goes beyond sentence-level NMT by incorporating inter-sentence context at the document level...

answer_2.quote: Evaluation. We use sacreBLEU (accuracy-related metric), COMET (semantics-related metric) with the wmt22-comet-da model, and BlonDe (discourse-related metric)...

answer_4.quote: We use the Direct Assessment (DA) method to manually assess the quality of translations generated by DeMPT and CMT-PT... Specifically, we recruit 6 professional translators...
answer_4.guideline: Given a source sentence, its translation from MT, and its human-produced reference translation, the evaluators are asked to give a score ranging from 0 to 100.
